categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of asset digital monitoring and operation management systems centered on distributed optical fiber sensors. Key product lines include power facility asset monitoring systems, submarine cable asset monitoring systems, urban utility tunnel asset monitoring systems, and port traffic asset monitoring systems. These products serve asset-intensive industries such as power grids, offshore wind power, municipal infrastructure, petrochemical, and port transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include distributed optical fiber sensing based on Raman, Brillouin, and Rayleigh scattering effects, embedded system optimization with FPGA and PowerPC architectures, high-resolution and long-distance optical fiber sensing, AIoT asset operation systems, edge computing gateways, and intelligent terminals. The company employs agile development and matrix management for R&D, with proprietary hardware and software platforms integrating sensing, communication, computing, and AI algorithms for predictive maintenance and lifecycle management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large state-owned enterprises and industry leaders in power grids (e.g., State Grid, Huaneng Group), submarine cable manufacturers (e.g., Zhongtian Technology, Hengtong Optoelectronics), construction and infrastructure companies (e.g., China Railway, Gezhouba Group), and port groups (e.g., Hebei Port Group). The company’s products are widely applied across China’s provinces in sectors including power transmission, offshore wind farms, urban utility tunnels, petrochemical facilities, and port logistics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with projects and customers distributed nationwide across various provinces and municipalities. There is no significant mention of overseas operations or markets in the report.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of sensing hardware and software systems for asset monitoring and operation management. It also provides integrated solutions and services directly to end customers in asset-intensive industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing distributed optical fiber sensing technologies, integrating AI and edge computing for predictive maintenance, expanding applications into emerging sectors such as port logistics and mining energy, and developing intelligent inspection robots. The company emphasizes continuous innovation with high R&D investment (36.03% of revenue in 2024), patent development, and participation in industry standard formulation to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of hardware and software systems, including asset monitoring sensors, gateways, intelligent terminals, and digital operation management platforms. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales and bidding processes, with some cooperation with agents. The company also provides related services such as installation and maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic suppliers in the distributed optical fiber sensing and asset digital monitoring industry in China. It holds a strong market position in power grid asset monitoring and offshore wind power cable monitoring, with recognized brand influence and participation in key national projects. Competitors include other domestic and international firms in optical sensing and industrial IoT sectors, but the company’s proprietary technologies and comprehensive solutions provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 182.47 million, a 40.06% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 67.57 million, reversing from prior profitability. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.29 billion with net assets of RMB 1.02 billion. The decline was mainly due to macroeconomic challenges, project delays, and increased R&D and sales expenses. Despite short-term setbacks, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and infrastructure expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company’s unique value lies in its proprietary distributed optical fiber sensing technology that offers long-distance, high-precision, real-time, and no-blind-spot monitoring with strong electromagnetic interference resistance and intrinsic safety. Its integrated AIoT platform combines sensing, edge computing, and AI algorithms to enable predictive maintenance and full lifecycle asset management. The modular, open, and scalable system architecture, combined with rich industry data and customized solutions, differentiates it in asset-intensive sectors requiring high reliability and intelligent operation.
